component.name: Pokee
component.summary: Native port of Monster Hunter Freedom Unite (USA)

description.p: Pokee is a native port of Monster Hunter Freedom Unite (USA) made by static recompilation: the game's PSP code is translated ahead of time into native code and runs on a reimplementation of the PSP system software, with Vulkan graphics, gamepad support and PSP-compatible saves.

Pokee does not include any game assets or original game files: no disc image, no copy of the game's executable or data, and no textures, models, audio or video from the game. You must provide the files from your own legally obtained copy of Monster Hunter Freedom Unite (USA, ULUS-10391, version 1.01): the first start checks that copy, accepts only that release, and sets the game up from it.
Pokee is built from Yakumo (https://github.com/TeamGDB/Yakumo) by its contributors. It is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by CAPCOM or Sony.
